_comment: Frame spec for the onboarding slide imagery. Raw screenshots live in design/onboarding/raw/ and are composited into public/onboarding/ by scripts/build_onboarding_frames.py. `crop` is [x, y, width, height] in source pixels, or null to use the whole image. All slides currently use the full screenshot (no cropping). Slides with `passthrough` reuse an existing asset as-is and are not rebuilt.
_panelNote: The modal paints the image panel the same mint (background, below) and uses object-contain, so the frame edge is invisible and the screenshot is never cropped.
